study_identification_part.si_4_title: Distinct Neurodevelopmental Patterns and Intermediate Integration-Based Predictive Modeling in Autism Spectral Disorder

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABIDE-I consists of 17 scanning sites with 874 participants after QA (481 TD + 393 ASD). ABIDE-II consists of 19 scanning sites with 871 participants after QA (469 TD + 402 ASD). KQJH is a single-site dataset originally collected for investigating associations between genetic, neuroimaging, and clinical data for children with ASD, with 264 participants after QA (48 TD + 216 ASD). Total after QA: 2009 participants (998 TD + 1011 ASD).

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: All three datasets were combined and used together for: (1) GAMLSS-based normative developmental trajectory modeling of cortical morphology (MCT, TSA, TGV) for both ASD and TD groups, split 70% train / 30% test; (2) case-control analyses comparing ASD vs TD on CT, SA, and GV; (3) LMFGCN deep-learning classification of ASD vs TD, split 80% train / 20% test with 10-fold cross-validation. The datasets were not used for distinct separate purposes; they were pooled and analyzed together.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Three separate GAMLSS normative models were built for MCT, TSA, and TGV respectively. All used the same TD (healthy control) dataset of 998 participants. The data was split 70% train / 30% test, yielding approximately 699 for training and 299 for testing (exact numbers not reported). TD breakdown: KQJH=48, ABIDE-I=481, ABIDE-II=469.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: All three normative models share the same TD dataset. The overall TD group mean age is 14.6 years (SD=7.52) as directly reported in Table 1. The age range for TD participants spans 0-64 years based on combining across datasets: KQJH TD 0-4 years, ABIDE-I TD 6-56 years, ABIDE-II TD 5-64 years. The min=0 comes from KQJH TD and max=64 comes from ABIDE-II TD. The train-phase (70% split) age statistics are not reported separately. Weighted mean verification from Table 1: (48*2.13 + 481*13.65 + 469*16.85) / 998 = (102.24 + 6565.65 + 7902.65) / 998 = 14570.54/998 = 14.60, consistent with reported total mean of 14.6.
